description: Mark a reviewed test plan as approved, so the generator may write tests from it. Call it ONLY after the user has read the plan and explicitly approved it in the chat, and pass their words as "approval": never approve a plan yourself. The approval and the time are written into the plan. If the user asks for changes, save the changed plan with planner_save_plan (a draft again) and ask again.

approval.description: The user's own words approving the plan, quoted from the chat (e.g. "looks good, generate the tests")

specFile.description: The plan to approve: a path, or its name in specs/ (e.g. "shopping-cart.md")

name: planner_approve_plan
